text:
[LCCO.5.4] Capture is snapshot-always. Continuation rules fire
using the snapshot values regardless of whether the originating
LHS facts remain in working memory at response time. An author
who needs re-match-against-live-fact semantics must use the
two-sibling form, where the matcher rule can include the live
fact in its LHS directly.

idris.name: Ltac_3_5__snapshot
idris.note: 'Capture is snapshot-always': the values as they were at the parent's firing, for `after`'s captures; continuations are not modelled, and the round trip through the value code is run, not proved (the LTAC.3.5 tie). A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_3_5__capture_snapshot
idris.note: 'Capture is snapshot-always': what the body reads at the follow-up's firing is what the parent's match held at the parent's, by substitution over every expression captured whole, for `after`'s captures; continuations are not modelled.

idris.name: ltac_3_5__rewrite
idris.note: The reads of the parent's match replaced by the timer's slots: the snapshot's shape, for `after`'s captures; continuations are not modelled. A fixture.
